column1: For dates of future publications please see the Office for National Statistics (ONS) Release Calendar.
Data tables shown in this workbook relate to the Crime Survey for England and Wales (CSEW).
Crime Survey for England and Wales (CSEW) estimates for the year ending March 2023 and year ending March 2024 are not designated as accredited official statistics.
column2: Quality of estimates from the Crime Survey for England and Wales

column1: Due to the suspension of the CSEW during the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, data are not available for the year ending March 2021 and the year ending March 2022

CSEW headline crime captures a range of personal and household victim-based crime in the interviewer-led parts of the survey, including violence with and without injury, robbery, theft, criminal damage, fraud and computer misuse. Experiences of sexual assault, stalking and harassment are not included but presented separately in our statistics
For explanatory notes on these statistics see the User guide to crime statistics for England and Wales.
